editorial:
Imagine you are just trying to get your ex-girlfriend back by showing her you have finally gotten your act together. That is exactly where Timo finds himself, but his plan goes south fast when he and his buddies get dragged into a messy drug war. You get to follow four regular guys who are completely out of their league, suddenly tasked with selling 22 kilos of drugs in just one week if they want to keep breathing. The vibe is a wild mix of panic and laughter, as you watch these friends scramble to survive a situation they are way too clumsy to handle.

What really works here is the chemistry between the friends, making the jokes land and the stress feel real. While some of the plot twists feel a bit predictable, the fast pace keeps you from getting bored. It is a great pick if you love stories about unlucky people in bad spots. For the best experience, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the chaotic action, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with your own crew.
endingExplained: After a week of absolute chaos, the group manages to deal with the drugs and face off against the criminals threatening them. Through a mix of luck and teamwork, they survive the conflict and settle the debt. Timo realizes that trying to impress his ex with a fake version of himself was a mistake. He finds peace with his friends, and the movie ends with them safe and bonded closer than ever before.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves chaotic comedies about friends in over their heads.
